task.name: Coordinate_camp_shift
task.when: Before and after every scheduled Morning, Afternoon, Pre-event, Bar, Liaison, Cheese, and Post-event shift

step.action: Identify the checklist types starting next.
Confirm that each assigned worker is present.
step.ifThen: IF an assigned worker is absent, THEN find a willing replacement and update 📦 Shift_Assignment_Sheet. IF no replacement is available, THEN record the coverage gap in 📦 Camp_Issue_Log and tell the Camp Lead.

step.action: Give each worker the applicable generated checklist and task cards.
Brief the workers on unresolved issues that affect their tasks.
Review every checklist line after the shift.
Record every BLOCKED, ESCALATED, or incomplete line in 📦 Camp_Issue_Log.

passWhen.criterion: Every shift has workers or a recorded coverage gap.
Every worker received the applicable checklist and task cards.
Every completed checklist line has status, initials, and completion time.
Every unresolved result is in the issue log.
